energy_convention: VASP free energy TOTEN; electronic entropy is zero for this integer-occupied atom

validation.independent_parser: ASE vasprun.xml energy agrees with parsed OUTCAR TOTEN
validation.scope: Vacuum and occupation checks at the dataset's fixed 400 eV cutoff; not a plane-wave cutoff convergence study

dataset_compatibility.bulk_energy_convention: VASP finite-smearing free energy TOTEN, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.15 eV
dataset_compatibility.atom_specific_choices: Spin-polarized ground-state atom, Gamma point, vacuum cell, and integer occupations with a small-Gaussian cross-check. Bulk metallic smearing is not imposed on the atom.

fitting_use.note: Hold the atomic reference fixed. Do not fit an additional unconstrained per-atom constant after subtracting this reference. This absolute atomic energy is specific to the recorded PAW and computational setup.
